    Interval-finiteness of the cover from a positive cocycle #

    A cocycle c with c e ≥ 1 on every arrow gives a height on the universal cover: the weight of the walk class of an object. It increases strictly along arrows of the cover, so intervals of the cover are finite and every finite set lies in a finite convex piece (hullFinite_of_posCocycle). Without long morphisms the constant weight 1 is a cocycle (hullFinite_of_not_hasLong).
